el-a.label: a with href
el-a.text: Roles: button, checkbox, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, option, radio, switch, tab or treeitem. (link is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) DPub Roles: doc-backlink, doc-biblioref, doc-glossref or doc-noteref Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. It is NOT RECOMMENDED to use aria-disabled="true" on an a element with an href attribute. Note If a link needs to be programmatically communicated as "disabled", remove the href attribute.

el-a-no-href.label: a without href
el-a-no-href.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-abbr.label: abbr
el-abbr.text: Any role Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-address.label: address
el-address.text: Any role, though group is NOT RECOMMENDED. Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-area.label: area with href
el-area.text: No role other than link, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the link role.

el-area-no-href.label: area without href
el-area-no-href.text: Roles: button or link. (generic is also allowed, but SHOULD NOT be used.) Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-article.label: article
el-article.text: Roles: application, document, feed, main, none, presentation or region. (article is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-aside.label: aside
el-aside.text: Roles: feed, none, note, presentation, region or search. (complementary is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) DPub Roles: doc-dedication, doc-example, doc-footnote, doc-glossary, doc-pullquote or doc-tip Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-audio.label: audio
el-audio.text: Role: application Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the application role.

el-autonomous-custom-element.label: autonomous custom element
el-autonomous-custom-element.text: If role defined by ElementInternals, no role Otherwise, any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited if exposed as the generic role, or if exposed as another role which prohibits naming. Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-b.label: b
el-b.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-bdi.label: bdi
el-bdi.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-bdo.label: bdo
el-bdo.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-blockquote.label: blockquote
el-blockquote.text: Any role, though blockquote is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-body.label: body
el-body.text: No role other than generic, which SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes allowed for the generic role, with the exception that authors MUST NOT specify aria-hidden=true on the body element.

el-br.label: br
el-br.text: Roles: none or presentation Authors MAY specify the aria-hidden attribute on the br element. Otherwise, no other allowed aria-* attributes.

el-button.label: button
el-button.text: Roles: checkbox, combobox, gridcell, link, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, option, radio, separator, slider, switch, tab, or treeitem. (button is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. If the button is the first child of a select element: No role or aria-* attributes

el-canvas.label: canvas
el-canvas.text: Any role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-caption.label: caption
el-caption.text: No role other than caption, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes.

el-cite.label: cite
el-cite.text: Any role Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-code.label: code
el-code.text: Any role, though code is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-data.label: data
el-data.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-datalist.label: datalist
el-datalist.text: No role other than listbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. No aria-* attributes.

el-dd.label: dd
el-dd.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the definition role.

el-del.label: del
el-del.text: Any role, though deletion is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-details.label: details
el-details.text: No role other than group, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the group role.

el-dfn.label: dfn
el-dfn.text: Any role, though term is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-dialog.label: dialog
el-dialog.text: Role: alertdialog. (dialog is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the dialog role.

el-div.label: div
el-div.text: If a direct child of a dl element, only presentation or none. Otherwise, any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-dl.label: dl
el-dl.text: Roles: group, list, none or presentation Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-dt.label: dt
el-dt.text: Role: listitem Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-em.label: em
el-em.text: Any role, though emphasis is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-embed.label: embed
el-embed.text: Roles: application, document, img, image, none or presentation. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-fieldset.label: fieldset
el-fieldset.text: Roles: none, presentation or radiogroup. (group is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-figcaption.label: figcaption
el-figcaption.text: Roles: group, none or presentation Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-figure.label: figure
el-figure.text: If the figure has a valid figcaption descendant: No role other than figure, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. DPub Role: doc-example. Otherwise, if the figure has no figcaption descendant: Any role, though figure is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-footer.label: footer
el-footer.text: Roles: group, presentation or none. (If not a descendant of an article, aside, main, nav or section element, or an element with role=article, complementary, main, navigation or region, then role=contentinfo is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. Otherwise, role=generic is also allowed, but SHOULD NOT be used.) DPub Role: doc-footnote Naming Prohibited if exposed as generic. Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-form.label: form
el-form.text: Roles: none, presentation or search. (form is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Note A form is not exposed as a landmark region unless it has been provided an accessible name.

el-form-associated-custom-element.label: form-associated custom element
el-form-associated-custom-element.text: If role defined by ElementInternals, no role Otherwise, form-related roles: button, checkbox, combobox, listbox, progressbar, group, radio, radiogroup, searchbox, slider, spinbutton, switch or textbox. (generic is also allowed, but SHOULD NOT be used.) Naming Prohibited if exposed as the generic role. Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-h1-h6.label: h1 to h6
el-h1-h6.text: Roles: none, presentation or tab. (heading is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) DPub Role: doc-subtitle Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-header.label: header
el-header.text: Roles: group, none or presentation. (If not a descendant of an article, aside, main, nav or section element, or an element with role=article, complementary, main, navigation or region, then role=banner is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. Otherwise, role=generic is also allowed, but SHOULD NOT be used.) Naming Prohibited if exposed as generic. Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-hgroup.label: hgroup
el-hgroup.text: Any role, though group is NOT RECOMMENDED. Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-hr.label: hr
el-hr.text: Roles: none or presentation. (separator is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) DPub Role: doc-pagebreak Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the separator role.

el-html.label: html
el-html.text: No role other than document or generic, which are NOT RECOMMENDED. No aria-* attributes.

el-i.label: i
el-i.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-iframe.label: iframe
el-iframe.text: Roles: application, document, img, image, none or presentation. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-img.label: img
el-img.text: Roles: button, checkbox, link, math, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, meter, option, progressbar, radio, scrollbar, separator, slider, switch, tab or treeitem. (img or image is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) DPub Role: doc-cover Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. If the img has no alt attribute or no accessible name: No role other than the role=none or presentation roles. (role=img or image is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.)

el-img-no-name.label: img with empty alt and no accessible name
el-img-no-name.text: No role other than the role=none or presentation roles, which are NOT RECOMMENDED. No aria-* attributes except aria-hidden="true".

el-input-button.label: input type=button
el-input-button.text: Roles: checkbox, combobox, gridcell, link, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, option, radio, separator, slider, switch, tab, or treeitem. (button is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-input-checkbox.label: input type=checkbox
el-input-checkbox.text: Roles: menuitemcheckbox, option or switch; button if used with aria-pressed. (checkbox is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Authors MUST NOT use the aria-checked attribute on input type=checkbox elements. Otherwise, any Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Note The HTML checked attribute can be used instead of the aria-checked attribute for menuitemcheckbox, option or switch roles when used on type=checkbox.

el-input-color.label: input type=color
el-input-color.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and aria-disabled attribute.

el-input-date.label: input type=date
el-input-date.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-datetime-local.label: input type=datetime-local
el-input-datetime-local.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-email.label: input type=email with no list attribute
el-input-email.text: No role other than textbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-file.label: input type=file
el-input-file.text: No role Global aria-* attributes, aria-disabled, aria-invalid and aria-required attributes.

el-input-image.label: input type=image
el-input-image.text: The following roles are allowed, but are NOT RECOMMENDED: button, checkbox, gridcell, link, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, option, radio, separator, slider, switch, tab or treeitem. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. If possible, authors SHOULD consider using a different HTML element which allows the specified role, such as the button element.

el-input-month.label: input type=month
el-input-month.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-number.label: input type=number
el-input-number.text: No role other than spinbutton, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the spinbutton role.

el-input-password.label: input type=password
el-input-password.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-radio.label: input type=radio
el-input-radio.text: Role: menuitemradio. (radio is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Authors MUST NOT use the aria-checked attribute on input type=radio elements. Otherwise, any Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Note The HTML checked attribute can be used instead of the aria-checked attribute for the menuitemradio role when used on type=radio.

el-input-range.label: input type=range
el-input-range.text: No role other than slider, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Authors SHOULD NOT use the aria-valuemax or aria-valuemin attributes on input type=range. Otherwise, any global aria-* attributes and any other aria-* attributes applicable to the slider role.

el-input-reset.label: input type=reset
el-input-reset.text: The following roles are allowed, but are NOT RECOMMENDED: button, checkbox, combobox, gridcell, link, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, option, radio, separator, slider, switch, tab or treeitem. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. If possible, authors SHOULD consider using a different HTML element which allows the specified role, such as the button element.

el-input-search.label: input type=search, with no list attribute
el-input-search.text: No role other than searchbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the searchbox role.

el-input-submit.label: input type=submit
el-input-submit.text: The following roles are allowed, but are NOT RECOMMENDED: button, checkbox, combobox, gridcell, link, menuitem, menuitemcheckbox, menuitemradio, option, radio, separator, slider, switch, tab or treeitem. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. If possible, authors SHOULD consider using a different HTML element which allows the specified role, such as the button element.

el-input-tel.label: input type=tel, with no list attribute
el-input-tel.text: No role other than textbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-text.label: input type=text or with a missing or invalid type, with no list attribute
el-input-text.text: Roles: combobox, searchbox or spinbutton. (textbox is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-input-text-list.label: input type=text, search, tel, url, email, or with a missing or invalid type, with a list attribute
el-input-text-list.text: No role other than combobox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Authors SHOULD NOT use the aria-haspopup attribute on the indicated inputs with a list attribute. Otherwise, any global aria-* attributes and any other aria-* attributes applicable to the combobox role.

el-input-time.label: input type=time
el-input-time.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-url.label: input type=url with no list attribute
el-input-url.text: No role other than textbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-input-week.label: input type=week
el-input-week.text: No role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-ins.label: ins
el-ins.text: Any role, though insertion is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-kbd.label: kbd
el-kbd.text: Any role Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-label.label: label
el-label.text: If a label element is implicitly or explicitly associated with a labelable element then no role Otherwise, if the label is not associated with an element then any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited if exposed as the generic role, or if exposed as another role which prohibits naming. Otherwise, global aria-* attributes.

el-legend.label: legend
el-legend.text: No role Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes.

el-li.label: li
el-li.text: No role other than listitem, which is NOT RECOMMENDED, if the parent list element has an implicit or explicit list role. Otherwise, any role if the parent list element does not expose an implicit or explicit list role. Note See ul, ol, or menu for allowed roles for list elements. Globalaria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Authors SHOULD NOT use the following deprecated DPub Roles: doc-biblioentry, doc-endnote.

el-main.label: main
el-main.text: No role other than main, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the main role.

el-mark.label: mark
el-mark.text: Any role Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-math.label: math
el-math.text: No role other than math, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the math role.

el-menu.label: menu
el-menu.text: Roles: group, listbox, menu, menubar, none, presentation, radiogroup, tablist, toolbar or tree. (list is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Authors SHOULD NOT use deprecated directory role.

el-meter.label: meter
el-meter.text: No role other than meter, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Authors SHOULD NOT use the aria-valuemax or aria-valuemin attributes on meter elements. Otherwise, any global aria-* attributes and any other aria-* attributes applicable to the meter role.

el-nav.label: nav
el-nav.text: Roles: menu, menubar, none, presentation or tablist. (navigation is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) DPub Roles: doc-index, doc-pagelist or doc-toc Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-object.label: object
el-object.text: Roles: application, document, img or image. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-ol.label: ol
el-ol.text: Roles: group, listbox, menu, menubar, none, presentation, radiogroup, tablist, toolbar or tree. (list is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Authors SHOULD NOT use deprecated directory role.

el-optgroup.label: optgroup
el-optgroup.text: No role other than group, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the group role.

el-option.label: option element that is in a list of options or that represents a suggestion in a datalist
el-option.text: No role other than option, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Authors SHOULD NOT use the aria-selected attribute on the option element. Global aria-* attributes and any other aria-* attributes applicable to the option role.

el-output.label: output
el-output.text: Any role, though status is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-p.label: p
el-p.text: Any role, though paragraph is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-picture.label: picture
el-picture.text: No role Authors MAY specify the aria-hidden attribute on the picture element. Otherwise, no other allowed aria-* attributes.

el-pre.label: pre
el-pre.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-progress.label: progress
el-progress.text: No role other than progressbar, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Authors SHOULD NOT use the aria-valuemax attribute on progress elements. Otherwise, any Global aria-* attributes and any other aria-* attributes applicable to the progressbar role.

el-q.label: q
el-q.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-rp.label: rp
el-rp.text: Any role Naming Prohibited Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-rt.label: rt
el-rt.text: Any role Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-ruby.label: ruby
el-ruby.text: Any role Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-s.label: s
el-s.text: Any role, though deletion is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-samp.label: samp
el-samp.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-search.label: search
el-search.text: Roles: form, group, none, presentation or region. (search is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-section.label: section
el-section.text: Roles: alert, alertdialog, application, banner, complementary, contentinfo, dialog, document, feed, group, log, main, marquee, navigation, none, note, presentation, search, status or tabpanel. (role=region is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. role=generic SHOULD NOT be used.) DPub Roles: doc-abstract, doc-acknowledgments, doc-afterword, doc-appendix, doc-bibliography, doc-chapter, doc-colophon, doc-conclusion, doc-credit, doc-credits, doc-dedication, doc-endnotes, doc-epigraph, doc-epilogue, doc-errata, doc-example, doc-foreword, doc-glossary, doc-index, doc-introduction, doc-notice, doc-pagelist, doc-part, doc-preface, doc-prologue, doc-pullquote, doc-qna, doc-toc Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-select.label: select (rendered as a drop-down box)
el-select.text: Role: menu. (combobox is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Authors SHOULD NOT use the aria-multiselectable attribute on a select element. Otherwise, any Global aria-* attributes and any other aria-* attributes applicable to the combobox or menu role.

el-select-multiple-or-size-greater-1.label: select (rendered as a list box)
el-select-multiple-or-size-greater-1.text: No role other than listbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Authors SHOULD NOT use the aria-multiselectable attribute on a select element. Otherwise, any Global aria-* attributes and any other aria-* attributes applicable to the listbox role.

el-selectedcontent.label: selectedcontent
el-selectedcontent.text: If used as a valid descendant of a select element: no role or aria-* attributes Otherwise, any role if the element is used outside of its intended context as a child of the button part of a customizable select element, though generic is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-small.label: small
el-small.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-span.label: span
el-span.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-strong.label: strong
el-strong.text: Any role, though strong is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-sub.label: sub
el-sub.text: Any role, though subscript is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-summary.label: summary
el-summary.text: No role if the summary element is a summary for its parent details element. Global aria-* attributes, aria-disabled, and aria-haspopup attributes. Otherwise, if the summary element is not a summary for its parent details element, authors MAY specify any role, and any Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-sup.label: sup
el-sup.text: Any role, though superscript is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-svg.label: SVG
el-svg.text: Any role, though graphics-document is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-table.label: table
el-table.text: Any role, though table is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-tbody.label: tbody
el-tbody.text: Any role, though rowgroup is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-td.label: td
el-td.text: If the ancestor table element has role=table, grid, or treegrid, no role other than the following: If the ancestor table element is exposed as a role=table, then cell is allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. If the ancestor table element is exposed as a role=grid or treegrid, then gridcell is allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. Otherwise, if the ancestor table element is not exposed as a role=table, grid or treegrid, any role. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-textarea.label: textarea
el-textarea.text: No role other than textbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the textbox role.

el-tfoot.label: tfoot
el-tfoot.text: Any role, though rowgroup is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-th.label: th
el-th.text: If the ancestor table element has role=table, grid, or treegrid, no role other than the following: If the ancestor table element is exposed as a role=table, then columnheader, rowheader and cell are allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. If the ancestor table element is exposed as a role=grid or treegrid, then columnheader, rowheader or gridcell are allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. Otherwise, if the ancestor table element is not exposed as a role=table, grid or treegrid, any role. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-thead.label: thead
el-thead.text: Any role, though rowgroup is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-time.label: time
el-time.text: Any role, though time is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-tr.label: tr
el-tr.text: If the ancestor table element has role=table, grid, or treegrid, no role other than row, which is NOT RECOMMENDED; otherwise any role, though row is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-u.label: u
el-u.text: Any role, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-ul.label: ul
el-ul.text: Roles: group, listbox, menu, menubar, none, presentation, radiogroup, tablist, toolbar or tree. (list is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Authors SHOULD NOT use the deprecated directory role.

el-var.label: var
el-var.text: Any role Naming Prohibited Otherwise, Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-video.label: video
el-video.text: Role: application Global aria-* attributes and any aria-* attributes applicable to the application role.

el-wbr.label: wbr
el-wbr.text: Roles: none or presentation Authors MAY specify the aria-hidden attribute on the wbr element. Otherwise, no other allowed aria-* attributes.
